title.narrative: Enhancing the effectiveness of priority national health coverage programs
Mejora de la efectividad de programas nacionales prioritarios de cobertura en salud

description.narrative: El objetivo general del proyecto es contribuir a mejorar los resultados sanitarios de la poblacin con cobertura pblica exclusiva, fortaleciendo la efectividad de intervenciones prioritarias en prevencin y tratamiento. Los objetivos especficos del proyecto son: (i) alcanzar niveles adecuados de cobertura efectiva en inmunizaciones del calendario nacional; (ii) mejorar la cobertura y la continuidad en el acceso a medicamentos esenciales en atencin primaria, a travs de una gestin ms integrada de la demanda entre la Nacin y las provincias; y (iii) incrementar la cobertura efectiva de prestaciones bsicas prioritarias en salud materno-infantil y enfermedades crnicas, optimizando el modelo de financiamiento por resultados del Programa SUMAR+, alineando sus incentivos con la cobertura efectiva y fortaleciendo su contribucin a la inteligencia sanitaria nacional.

The general development objective of the project is to contribute to improved health outcomes among the population with exclusive public coverage by strengthening the effectiveness of priority interventions in prevention and treatment. The specific development objectives of the project are: (i) to achieve adequate levels of effective coverage for immunizations under the national schedule; (ii) to improve coverage and continuity in access to essential medicines in primary care through more integrated demand management between the national and provincial levels; and (iii) to increase the effective coverage of priority basic services in maternal and child health and chronic diseases by optimizing the results-based financing model of the SUMAR+ Program, aligning its incentives with effective coverage and strengthening its contribution to national health intelligence.
